text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
D-Duramente-san!
May I ask you one thing... !?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You've been using the training machine way in the back lately, right?
Rumor has it that a ghost appears there at night, so—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!? I-I'm so sorry for bringing up such a boring topic~~!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: You're making quite a face... What happened?
You're making quite a face... What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'll hold off on using the machine in the back for a while.
